items.title: Items in the feeds
items.description: All active items, or only those with an image (shopping catalogues refuse items without one).

includeOutOfStock.title: Include items out of stock
includeOutOfStock.description: Listed as out of stock; off leaves them out of the feeds.

skuAs.title: Send the SKU as
skuAs.description: Shopping catalogues match items by GTIN (barcode) or MPN (manufacturer part number). Choose what your SKUs are.

gradedCondition.title: Condition of graded items
gradedCondition.description: The condition sent for items that have a condition grade. Items without a grade are new.
